logicalRecallRule: One successful recall receipt in any attempt for the same original Matrix event is sufficient. Background review retries need not repeat a completed retrieval. All answer, room, original speaker and status checks remain unchanged.
rawResults: Frozen runner last-attempt checks, failures, attempts and call IDs remain unmodified and are published separately.
gapRule: Global interactions across the three Bots; the changed location uses its correction at round 48, giving 145 interactions to its final check. Unchanged values have a 192-interaction gap.
